svg.title: SD09 — Reach Ending (UC13, F12; Template Method)

g.text: SD09 — Reach Ending (UC13, F12; Template Method)
body of GameController.endGame(), referenced by SD02 and SD04
Called from SD02 when isGameOver() is true:
the main quest completed, or the player's HP reached 0 (SD04).
sum of getAlignmentDelta() over all events:
+2 per side quest completed for an NPC,
−1 per failed quest, −2 per item stolen from an NPC
DEATH if the player died; otherwise
(prompt includes the fixed facts from story memory;
isValid: mentions only recorded events and fits the ending type;
fallback: template epilogue for the ending type)
